tool_args.rationale: The first saturating-only model was refuted on fresh confirmation, while the two acquired gradient-extreme rows resolve the previously hidden gradient dependence. Fit the known bridge siphon law with its signed square-root branch to all seven observations; parameters are fitted numerically and retained for prediction, avoiding the earlier undefined train_rows error.

considered_alternatives.option: Acquire extra_fine_trajectory_batch for a coupled memory ODE
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The seven rows include diverse u_now and s_grad at the same H; the verified thermal-fin bridge maps to the static inland-hub siphon, and there is no specific evidence requiring memory dynamics.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating siphon without the open branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A previous fixed-gradient saturating fit failed fresh confirmation badly; the acquired gradient extremes show an additional branch contribution is needed.

No high-frequency chaotic-sign signature or refutation of all smooth stationary mechanisms is present; the observations are consistent with a stationary gradient-inhibited siphon with an open signed sqrt branch.
